Welcome to the Hall of Opportunity! This
table is Craps! Would you like a quick
Craps is a quick dice game where you bet on
either the Pass Line or the Don’t Pass Line.
After you place your wager, two dice are rolled
A Pass Line bet wins immediately on 7 or 11,
and loses on 2, 3, or 12. A Don’t Pass bet wins
on 2 or 3, loses on 7 or 11, and a roll of 12
is a push that returns your bet.
If any other number is rolled, that number
becomes the Point. The dice are rolled again
until either the Point or a 7 appears. Pass
Line wins if the Point is rolled again first,
while Don’t Pass wins if a 7 appears first.
